# Semantic UI

> A reactive web component framework built on signals and web standards

Base URL: https://next.semantic-ui.com

## How This Works

Manifests return metadata (path, title, description, token count per item).
Fetch individual items via their `path` field to get actual content.

**Manifest formats:**
- `manifest.json` - Human-readable, full metadata
- `manifest.min.json` - Minified, full metadata
- `index.min.json` - Minified, slim (path, title, tokens only)

## Decision Tree

**Using UI components in a project?**
- Component Specs: /content/specs/index.min.json (~12k content tokens)
- Examples: /content/examples/index.min.json (~105k content tokens)
- AI Context (ui): /content/ai/ui/index.min.json (~3k content tokens)

**Building custom components with the framework?**
- AI Context (framework): /content/ai/framework/index.min.json (~93k content tokens)
- User Documentation: /content/docs/index.min.json (~150k content tokens)

**Contributing to Semantic UI?**
- AI Context (contributing): /content/ai/contributing/index.min.json (~159k content tokens)

**Building your own UI framework or design system?**
- AI Context (research): /content/ai/research/index.min.json (~3.3M content tokens)
- Specialized corpus analyzing UI primitives across major JS frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, etc.). Intended for: framework authors, design system architects, academics, AI/ML researchers training on UI patterns. This was the research foundation for Semantic UI's component specs.

---

## Component Specs

Machine-readable component API definitions (states, variations, settings, examples).

~12k content tokens total.

| Format | Path | Tokens |
|--------|------|--------|
| Slim | /content/specs/index.min.json | ~300 |
| Full | /content/specs/manifest.json | ~1.5k |

Files: /content/specs/{component}.json (e.g., button.json, menu.json)
Direct access: If you know the component name, fetch directly. Use manifest for discovery.

## Examples

Interactive code examples with source files.

~105k content tokens total.

| Format | Path | Tokens |
|--------|------|--------|
| Slim | /content/examples/index.min.json | ~8k |
| Full | /content/examples/manifest.json | ~31k |

Files: /content/examples/{id}.json

## User Documentation

Comprehensive docs, guides, and tutorials.

~150k content tokens total.

| Format | Path | Tokens |
|--------|------|--------|
| Slim | /content/docs/index.min.json | ~2.5k |
| Full | /content/docs/manifest.json | ~10k |

Files: /content/docs/{path}.md

## AI Context

Curated documentation optimized for AI agents.

~3.5M content tokens total (mostly research).

| Audience | Slim Index | Content Tokens |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| ui | /content/ai/ui/index.min.json | ~3k |
| framework | /content/ai/framework/index.min.json | ~93k |
| contributing | /content/ai/contributing/index.min.json | ~159k |
| research | /content/ai/research/index.min.json | ~3.3M |

Combined manifests:
- Slim: /content/ai/index.min.json
- Full: /content/ai/manifest.json

Raw files: /content/ai/{audience}/{slug}.md

## Full Manifest

All content types combined. Not for context loading - intended for tooling, scrapers, and indexing systems.

/content/manifest.json
